projects.name: Akordi
projects.client: Laing O’Rourke | Role: Product Manager| Team Size: 30| Duration: July 2024 – Present
details: Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Pivotal Tracker, Python, SQL, APIs, Gitlab.
Description: Akordi is a web -based progressive application developed for engineers in the construction
industry to streamline their daily activities. It centralizes data from ongoing Laing O’Rourke projects and
assigns user-specific workspaces, enabling engineers to access and contribute project-related information
collaboratively within their teams. Designed with a user -focused approach, the platform integrates
generative AI to interpret uploaded documents and provide intelligent responses, supporting enhanced
productivity and paving the way for future growth through AI-driven innovations.
Responsibilities:
• Owned product roadmap and execution for a GenAI-enabled SaaS platform used by engineers.
• Drove a 50% improvement in client retention by prioritizing high-impact workflows and AI- assisted document intelligence.
• Defined MVP scope, success metrics, and phased roadmap aligned with business outcomes and
adoption goals.
• Led stakeholder and client requirement analysis to validate problem statements, drive feature
prioritization, and ensure alignment with business goals.
• Partnered with cross-functional and distributed teams (engineering, design, sales) to deliver bi- weekly releases through Agile ceremonies.
• Defined and prioritized the AI product roadmap covering Agentic AI, RAG, LLM and intelligent
automation capabilities, translating customer/business requirements into scalable AI features
and measurable product outcomes
• Created and maintained documentation including FRD, BRD, SRS, epics, and user stories to ensure clear communication across teams.
• Established KPI tracking and ROI analysis to guide investment decisions and executive reporting.
Persistent Systems (Bengaluru)

projects.client: ConnectSphere, Horizon Networks | Role: Product Manager / Product Owner | Team Size: 20 |
projects.duration: June 2022 – March 2023| Environment: JIRA, Confluence, Figma, APIs, Swagger, SQL
details: Description: OmniLink is a next-gen telecom order management and service provisioning platform built
for major telecom providers, ConnectSphere and Horizon Networks. It streamlined customer onboarding
across broadband, mobile, and VoIP services by unifying service journeys and automating backend
provisioning. The platform integrated with legacy OSS/BSS systems, enabling real-time tracking,
reducing manual interventions, and significantly improving service activation timelines and customer
experience.
Responsibilities:
• Managed the design and delivery of a cloud-based order management platform, reducing
provisioning time by 75%.
• Defined the product roadmap and MVP in alignment with business goals and customer pain
points.
• Defined end-to-end service journeys across broadband, mobile, and VoIP, improving order
success rate by 35%
• Partnered with UI/UX teams to improve user journeys, enhancing order success and customer
satisfaction.
• Oversaw seamless integration with OSS/BSS systems to enable automation and accurate data
flow.
• Created and maintained user stories, epics, and documentation in JIRA and Confluence.
• Led UAT efforts, coordinated release plans, and supported internal training and change
management.
• Developed and presented financial and performance reports to senior leadership, providing
transparency on product health and profitability.
• Assisted in preparing budget forecasts and resource utilization plans, optimizing project costs
without compromising delivery timelines.
• Tracked KPIs post-launch, achieving a 35% increase in successful order completions and reduced
inquiries.
Mediaagility Pvt. Ltd (Acquired by Persistent Systems)

projects.name: SP Portal
projects.client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 |
details: Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations,
supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who
oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by
enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application
features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple
claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate
actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.
Responsibilities
• Gathered and analyzed business requirements, system specifications, and translated them into BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
• Defined project scope, timelines, and strategies; facilitated stakeholder meetings and
workshops for requirement clarification.
• Acted as a liaison between business, QA, and development teams, ensuring defect resolution,
quality delivery, and smooth release cycles.
• Planned and executed UAT, analyzed gaps, and recommended process improvements for better
business outcomes.
• Utilized tools like JIRA, Confluence, and Katalon Studio for documentation, traceability, and
process optimization.

projects.client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 6 | Duration: Oct 2021 – Apr 2022
details: | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git
Description: Whirlpool Sales Strategy and Operations is a progressive web application developed for

internal use within Whirlpool. It supports three distinct user roles —Admin, Editor, and General User — each with role-specific access and permissions. The application serves as a centralized platform to display
ongoing organizational projects, offering complete project details, trending updates, quick links, and

progress reports. It also includes features such as user location tracking to enhance visibility. Designed to be user -friendly, the application ensures a seamless experience across mobile, desktop, and tablet
devices, with the goal of improving accessibility and engagement for all users.
Responsibilities
• Analysed system specifications and translated requirements into detailed documentation,
scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
• Coordinated with developers, QA, and clients to track defects, ensure quality, and deliver
seamless product releases.
• Led multi-device, cross-platform verification, UAT planning, and execution to validate business
needs.
• Supported automation initiatives and database validations, recommending improvements for
better system performance.

projects.name: Cadent
projects.client: Cadent- Gas Network | Role: Product Owner / Test Engineer | Team Size: 7 | Duration: Jan 2021
details: – Jan 2022 | Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Cadent is a progressive web application designed to manage new and existing gas
connections across European regions, ensuring seamless customer service delivery. The platform allows
users to submit connection, site, contact, and payment details through an intuitive web form. Based on
location and site plans, the system generates detailed quotations and assigns application numbers for
processing through an admin portal. This application streamlines customer requests, optimizes
connection workflows, and enhances service delivery.
Responsibilities
• Analysed business needs, created BRDs, FRDs, workflows, and user stories, and defined
acceptance criteria for development.
• Collaborated with stakeholders, developers, and QA to ensure requirement clarity, defect
resolution, and smooth releases.
• Conducted gap analysis, UAT planning, and data validation to deliver a seamless, cross-platform
customer experience.
Sharpflux Technologies Pvt. Ltd (freelancer, Pune)

projects.name: Chibbs
projects.client: Chibbs | Role: Software Engineer | Team Size: 12 | Duration: Aug 2019 – Dec 2021 |
details: Environment: JIRA, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Chibbs is an online marketplace for homemade food, offering customers a seamless
experience similar to platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. The app provides a wide range of cuisines,
supports multiple payment methods (debit/credit cards, UPI, wallets, COD), and includes dedicated
interfaces for buyers, sellers, and delivery partners. The platform is designed to ensure a simple, user- friendly ordering and fulfilment process for all stakeholders.
Responsibilities:
• Gathered and documented business requirements, workflows, and use cases, translating them
into detailed specifications.
• Collaborated with stakeholders, development, and QA teams to align features with business
needs and ensure smooth releases.
• Defined user journeys, wireframes, and acceptance criteria to optimize user experience across
buyer, seller, and delivery apps.
• Supported UAT planning, defect triage, and process improvements for a stable, customer- centric platform.
Flextronics Pvt. Ltd., Pune

projects.client: Whirlpool | Role: Product Owner | Team Size: 8 | Duration: Apr 2021 – Feb 2022 |
details: Environment: Pivotal tracker, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: SP Portal is a progressive web application developed for Whirlpool's internal operations,
supporting multiple user roles including District Managers, Service Providers, and Administrators who
oversee overall application management. Its primary purpose is to streamline the claims process by
enabling users to filter and manage claims based on status, time, and other criteria. The application
features a dedicated section for viewing individual claim details & another for consolidating multiple
claims using claim numbers. It facilitates smooth claim processing by allowing District Managers to initiate
actions which are then carried forward by Service Providers, ensuring efficient and organized workflow.

business outcomes.

process optimization.

projects.client: Chibbs | Role: Software Engineer | Team Size: 12 | Duration: Aug 2019 – Dec 2021 |
details: Environment: JIRA, Python, Cloud SQL, APIs, Git.
Description: Chibbs is an online marketplace for homemade food, offering customers a seamless
experience similar to platforms like Zomato and Swiggy. The app provides a wide range of cuisines,
supports multiple payment methods (debit/credit cards, UPI, wallets, COD), and includes dedicated
interfaces for buyers, sellers, and delivery partners. The platform is designed to ensure a simple, user- friendly ordering and fulfilment process for all stakeholders.

into detailed specifications.
• Collaborated with stakeholders, development, and QA teams to align features with business
needs and ensure smooth releases.
• Defined user journeys, wireframes, and acceptance criteria to optimize user experience across
buyer, seller, and delivery apps.
• Supported UAT planning, defect triage, and process improvements for a stable, customer- centric platform.
Flextronics Pvt. Ltd., Pune
